raw_segments.text: See, see, Darby's view of the United States, P-435.
In 1890, the number of states and territories had increased to 51, the population to 62,831,900,
and the area of the states, 3,602,990 square miles.
This does not include the Philippine Islands, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico.
Conservative estimate of the population of the Philippine Islands is 8 million.
That of Hawaii, by the census of 1897, was given at 109,020,
and the present estimated population of Puerto Rico is 900,000.
The area of the Philippine Islands is about 120,000 square miles.
That of Hawaii is 6,740 square miles,
and the area of Puerto Rico is about 3,600 square miles.
